items.title: Native: `!` on a host-bound method's result is refused ("unresolved receiver")
items.body: Found by the native census of kolt's server (2026-11-09, vilan 0.55.0; sweeps/order58/native-census.md). `parts[1].parse_f64()!` is refused: `the rust backend does not emit a ! assertion on an unresolved receiver yet`. A user-defined method works; hoisting into a `let` works. `try_assert` in vilan-rust gets no type for a host-bound method's result. kolt: store.vl:5239, dates.vl:53-55, lib/rich_text/clipboard.vl:125. Repro: `~/.vilan/native-census/repros/bang/`. Size S.

items.title: Native: B709 follow-ups - let-else with an awaited scrutinee; `for X is Some(let y)` loses its binder
items.body: Found by the native census of kolt's server (2026-11-09, vilan 0.55.0; sweeps/order58/native-census.md). (1) `call().await is Some(let x) else ret ..` emits a block scrutinee before `else`: rustc `right curly brace before else in a let...else statement not allowed`; fix: parenthesize. kolt: files.vl:265, mcp.vl:121, mcp_write.vl:648. Repro: `~/.vilan/native-census/repros/rustc/let_else_await.vl`. (2) `for f() is Some(let found) { .. found .. }` emits `while matches!(.., Some(found))`: E0425, the binder is lost; fix: `while let`. kolt: store.vl:5390. Repro: `~/.vilan/native-census/repros/rustc/while_is_some.vl`. Size S each.

items.title: Native: a `List<str>` at a `List<any>` parameter is E0308; std's own `Database::migrate` fails rustc
items.body: Found by the native census of kolt's server (2026-11-09, vilan 0.55.0; sweeps/order58/native-census.md). `expected Vec<Any>, found Vec<Rc<str>>`. std/src/db.vl:266 (`run_guarded(recorder, [step.name, now().millis])`) fails the same way, so ANY native program that migrates fails to build. kolt: store.vl:5560 (migrate), store.vl:1769, mcp.vl:720, 753. The minimum now: convert the elements at the boundary. Size S-M.

items.title: Native: SIGTERM with a detached forever task leaves the process alive
items.body: Found by the native census of kolt's server (2026-11-09, vilan 0.55.0; sweeps/order58/native-census.md). A detached `async { for { ..; sleep(3600000) } }` (kolt files.vl:126): after one SIGTERM the server stops listening but the process stays alive; a second signal prints `the program was stopped by a second termination request before its open connections ended` though no connection was open. node exits on the first SIGTERM. Repro: `~/.vilan/native-census/repros/sigterm/sigterm.vl`. Size S-M.
